name: The Blur
description: The Blur never stands still. An incredibly fast enemy who proves difficult to catch and impossible to escape.
abilities: After you perform an Action, you may move one space.

super.name: Instant Motion
super.effect: You gain 5 Speed tokens and 6 Rapid Strike tokens. As an Action during your own turn, or as a Reactive Action on an enemy's turn, you may spend a Rapid Strike token to move one space, then deal 1 damage to an adjacent enemy.
super.description: A super fast flurry of blows, letting you dash around the map and deal damage exactly where you need to.

name: The Giant
description: The Giant is big and very, very strong. With great strength and extended reach, they are quite dangerous.
abilities: You take up a 2x2 space on the battle grid.
Your maximum range is increased by 1.
You do not take Fall Damage.
You can move over Walls. When you do, they become Rubble, and you gain one Fatigue token.
You can Enhance a Hit one additional time.
At the start of each of your turns, you gain 2 Power tokens.

actions.name: Crush
actions.text:
Unblockable by Abilities and Tokens.
Deal 3 damage to an enemy within range.
9+: Deal 5 damage instead, and Crush is Unblockable.

super.name: Toss Aside
super.effect: Deal 3 damage to all enemies within range, then push all of those enemies up to 5 spaces each.
super.description: Simple, large, and powerful. Swat them away like the flies they are.

name: The Immortal
description: The Immortal drains life with every blow. An incredibly durable enemy who just. Won't. Die.
abilities: The first time you deal damage each turn, you Heal.

super.name: Burning Blood
super.effect: Deal 3 damage to an enemy within range, then you heal. For the rest of this Round, after you take damage, deal 1 damage and give 1 Burning token to the enemy that dealt damage to you.
super.description: Turns your immortality into a weapon. Even trying to put you down will simply lead to their demise.

name: The Machine
description: The Machine is perfection. It is built to do a task, and it will succeed without fail.
abilities: Your Stances are made up of one Style attached to two Forms.
You never roll Green Action Dice.

actions.name: Synchro Breaker
actions.text: Target an adjacent enemy and Disable all of their Abilities until the end of this turn.

super.name: Smash
super.effect: Deal 10 damage to an enemy within range.

name: The Necromancer
abilities: At the start of your turn, place a Copy into an empty space within range.
At the end of your turn, each of your Copies may Move 1, then each Copy deals 1 damage to one adjacent enemy.

actions.name: Arise, My Minion!
actions.text:
Create a Copy in an empty space within range. Both you and that Copy may Move 1.
Usable once per turn.

super.name: Immortal Army
super.effect: Summon up to 6 Copies within range. Then, each of those Copies may move one or two spaces, then they each deal 1 damage to one adjacent enemy. Iron tokens can be used to reduce this damage.
super.description: Summons even MORE undead to follow your commands, and immediately sends them forth to consume.

name: The Swarm
description: The Swarm is an army of one.
abilities: At the end of your turn, for each Copy you have in play, choose one: You gain 1 Power token; or you gain 1 Iron token; or you may move one space; or each of your Copies may move 1 space; or destroy a Copy to deal 1 damage to each enemy adjacent to it.

actions.name: En Masse
actions.text:
Create a Copy in an adjacent empty space.
3+: Create a Copy in an adjacent empty space.
5+: Swap spaces with a Copy within range, then Create a Copy in an adjacent empty space.
7+: Swap spaces with a Copy within range, then Create a Copy in an adjacent empty space.

super.name: Crawl Into View
super.effect: Place 4 Copies into spaces you can see. Then, each of those Copies may immediately take an Action as if you had spent a 3.
super.description: Cover the entire battlefield, then claim your space.

name: The Tank
abilities: You have Armor. Your Armor blocks 10 damage the first time it triggers each turn.
When you are Pushed or Pulled, you move one less space.

super.name: Armor Install
super.effect: Until the end of this Round, your Armor can be triggered twice per turn, and your Armor is not spent when it reduces a 1 damage hit to zero. Until the end of the next Round, opponents can only spend 1 Iron token to reduce your hits, and Weakness tokens only reduce your damage by 1 instead of 2.
super.description: Makes you as close to unkillable as is possible.

name: The Untouchable
abilities: At the start of your turn and when you Bleed, you gain one Control Token.
It only costs you 1 Control Token to Dodge an Action.

actions.name: Controlling
actions.text:
You gain 1 Control Token.
5+: You gain 1 more Control Token.

super.name: Lockdown Protocol
super.effect: Gain 4 Control tokens. For the rest of this fight, after you spend any Control tokens, deal 1 damage to each enemy within your range.
super.description: Reinstate your authority, and resume the untouchable control you wish to maintain.

name: The Twins
description: Two fighters, one unit. (Marked TBD in the beta rulebook.)
abilities: (Ability not yet written in the beta rulebook.)

super.name: Twin Combo
super.effect: One of you deals 3 damage to an adjacent enemy and pushes them three spaces. Then, the other one of you deals 3 damage to an adjacent enemy and pushes them 3 spaces. Then, each of you may teleport 3 spaces, and you each deal 1 damage to all enemies adjacent to your destination.
super.description: A difficult, coordinated dance of an attack.
